title: Agent context at session entry
scope: Research evidence read from source on 2026-10-12; each record states what it checked. Revalidate before relying on it as live behavior.

records.title: Global native startup instructions
records.moment: Before first agent turn, only if a verified native instruction mechanism loads it
records.current: No Yoke-owned global instruction publisher or yoke-global source was found in the inspected runtime trees. A native skill catalog entry exposes metadata, not the full skill body.
records.planned: FIRST-USER P4 specifies machine-wide orientation and a user-level yoke-global skill, not a universal SESSION.md or an explicitly selected global native instruction file.
proposed_content: Only the minimum Yoke recognition and routing seed: installed tool, current project/no-project distinction, help entry, and where to get full guidance.
If the required guarantee is before the first turn, select and verify a supported native loader per harness in D; otherwise honestly call P4 delivery the first supported context-bearing hook event.
Do not copy project worktree/claim/contribution rules into unrelated repositories.

records.title: Global orientation and yoke-global
records.moment: First supported context-bearing event; retry only if delivery was missed
records.current: Current orientation requires a .yoke project root. Cursor already has user-level Stop/SessionEnd backstops; these are not a global startup orientation.
records.planned: P1 makes session project optional; P2 installs/deduplicates user hooks; P3 scopes guards; P4 installs global orientation and yoke-global.
proposed_content: Identity and machine/connection readiness, no-project/registered-project context, one relevant next step, optional short cross-project status, and a yoke-global pointer.
Use yoke --help and https://upyoke.com/docs outside projects; do not point at cwd .yoke/docs.
Select/add projects globally, then carry intent into a session started in the selected project folder for /yoke onboard or item work.
Do not require a GitHub connection or sync as the price of continuing; preserve TUI sync silently off and later change.

records.title: Project-owned knowledge lookup
records.scope: this project’s real docs and installed Pack docs
records.moment: Project-specific planning/implementation or explicit project question
records.current: context_routing has an always entry and named topic entries carrying project-relative docs. Implement reads it through project-structure get, then reads matched files in the claimed lane. Missing config is advisory; a failed read is not empty configuration.
records.planned: Preserve existing project doc structure; add discoverable project-hub routing rather than moving project docs into .yoke/docs.
proposed_content: Product help is .yoke/docs; project architecture/process docs and docs/packs/<slug>/README.md remain project-owned.
Teach the context_routing read from project native guidance and reuse it in relevant skills/dispatch.
An empty project may have no hub yet; an established repo maps its existing hubs. Do not fabricate documents or pretend a failed lookup succeeded.

records.title: Project native instructions
records.moment: Native project instruction load before action; native hierarchy rules vary by harness
records.current: Project AGENTS.md managed region is installed once; project-owned text remains outside it. Claude also gets .claude/rules/session.md. Codex/Cursor use AGENTS.md. Native discovery has minimum engines and configuration conditions.
records.planned: JOURNEYS keeps static project guidance in AGENTS/rules.
proposed_content: Stable obligations that must bind before acting: scoped authority, claims/lanes, durable owners, output/data trust, required operation-home lookup and recovery after context loss.
A short product-help versus project-knowledge distinction and the registered context_routing lookup.
Keep current state, full command catalogs, full phase procedures and adoption situation catalogs out of this always-loaded channel.
Keep Yoke-repo private prod/stage and source-dev rules outside the shipped managed region.

records.title: Project startup orientation
records.scope: current installed project and native session
records.moment: Claude/Codex UserPromptSubmit; Cursor SessionStart; missed Cursor delivery retries on PostToolUse
records.current: Client renderer uses payload/filesystem/git, without a DB read, to supply session ID, root, optional branch/recent commit, drift/install advisories, trust/authority core and deep-read pointers. It requires a session ID and .yoke ancestor. It confirms emitted allow output and retries missed delivery.
records.planned: JOURNEYS proposes state-dependent project gaps such as template strategy, unstaffed plan or missing release setup.
proposed_content: Reserve orientation for identity, current scope, important readiness/degradation and a bounded next-step hint.
Fetch any proposed strategy/deploy/QA facts through existing authorized reads; unknown/unreachable is not configured or missing. Keep the current offline orientation available.
Do not inline the full main_agent packet or resend static AGENTS doctrine. Add only facts useful to the current task.
Treat delivery confirmation as emitted output evidence; separately prove model-visible receipt in D.
